source.exact_deadline_wording: Application for funding: can be submitted annually at the beginning of March
source.notes: No calendar deadline exists centrally, so no date is written. The official programme page states that participant deadlines are set by the home institution, while institutional accreditation and funding applications "can be submitted annually at the beginning of March" with the funding period starting 1 June - i.e. recurring annual timing, hence ANNUAL/recurring. Movetia also states "Next application deadline: spring 2027 likely under Erasmus+" and that "Detailed information will be published here in autumn 2026"; neither is a fixed date, so neither is converted into deadline_date. The already-passed Call 2026 institutional funding deadline (4 March 2026, stated on Movetia's SEMP how-to page) is deliberately not written. The shard's official_source_url https://outgoing.sbfi.admin.ch could not be reached (connection failure, HTTP 000, on three separate attempts); SERI's own page confirms Movetia is the body that "implements the funding measures on behalf of SERI" and points applicants to the Movetia website for conditions and procedures, which is why the Movetia programme page is cited as the official source.
